karty.priklad: O, dylet ti fod wedi fy atgoffa i.
karty.priklad_cs: Oh, you should have reminded me (bod → [f]od after dylet ti).
karty.mnemo: at + cof (memory): putting something back into the memory.

extra.pozn: atgoffa rhywun am / o rywbeth = to remind someone of something (soft mutation after am and o); sentence from the dialogue on p. 120

karty.priklad: Rhaid i ni gyfathrebu'n well.
karty.priklad_cs: We must communicate better (cyfathrebu → [g]yfathrebu after i).

extra.pozn: the book's definition: cysylltu trwy ysgrifennu neu siarad (p. 127); own example

karty.priklad: Beth mae'r gair yma'n ei olygu?
karty.priklad_cs: What does this word mean? (golygu → [o]lygu after ei, the g drops)
karty.mnemo: golwg (sight, view): an editor looks over the text – what does it mean?

extra.pozn: golygydd = editor, golygfa = view; ddim yn golygu dim byd = to mean nothing at all (p. 128); own example

sever.priklad: Be mae'r gair yma'n ei olygu?
sever.priklad_cs: What does this word mean? (golygu → [o]lygu after ei, the g drops)

karty.priklad: Hoffwn i ddysgu sut i wau.
karty.priklad_cs: I'd like to learn how to knit (dysgu → [dd]ysgu after hoffwn i; gwau → [w]au after i).
karty.mnemo: A GUY (GWAU) knitting himself a woolly scarf.

extra.pozn: the stem is gwe- (gweais, gweodd); in speech often avoided with gwneud (Wnes i wau…); Clwb Gwau Cymraeg (Robin Radio, p. 130); own example

karty.priklad: Aethon ni i snorclo yn Sir Benfro.
karty.priklad_cs: We went snorkelling in Pembrokeshire.
karty.mnemo: From English snorkel.

extra.pozn: from p. 126 (Siaradwch), own sentence

karty.priklad: Aethon ni i rafftio dŵr gwyn ar Afon Tryweryn.
karty.priklad_cs: We went white-water rafting on the River Tryweryn.
karty.mnemo: From English raft.

extra.pozn: rafftio dŵr gwyn = white-water rafting (p. 126); own sentence

karty.priklad: Roedd hi eisiau eu rhwystro nhw eto.
karty.priklad_cs: She wanted to stop them again.
karty.mnemo: A ROOSTER (RHWYS-tro) stands in the road and stops the traffic.

extra.pozn: rhwystr = obstacle; the book's definition: stopio (p. 127); sentence from the story on p. 128

sever.priklad: Roedd hi isio eu rhwystro nhw eto.
sever.priklad_cs: She wanted to stop them again.

karty.priklad: Mae'n ymddangos bod problem gyda'r ffurflen gais.
karty.priklad_cs: It seems there's a problem with the application form.
karty.mnemo: ym- + dangos (to show): to show yourself.

extra.pozn: mae'n ymddangos bod… = it seems that…; sentence from the dialogue on p. 120

sever.priklad: Mae'n ymddangos bod problem efo'r ffurflen gais.
sever.priklad_cs: It seems there's a problem with the application form.

karty.priklad: Mae hi'n greadigol iawn.
karty.priklad_cs: She's very creative (creadigol → [g]readigol after 'n).
karty.mnemo: creu (to create) + -adigol.

extra.pozn: creu = to create (L2); own example

karty.priklad: Fasech chi'n dweud eich bod chi'n berson cymdeithasol?
karty.priklad_cs: Would you say you're a sociable person? (person → [b]erson after 'n)
karty.mnemo: cymdeithas (society) + -ol.

extra.pozn: cymdeithas = society, association (L1); sentence from p. 126

karty.priklad: Roedd hi'n ddamwain ddifrifol.
karty.priklad_cs: It was a serious accident (damwain → [dd]amwain after 'n; difrifol → [dd]ifrifol after the feminine damwain).
karty.mnemo: o ddifri = seriously: difrifol = serious.

extra.pozn: o ddifri = seriously (L14); sentence from p. 119

karty.priklad: Roedd Ann yn ferch hardd iawn.
karty.priklad_cs: Ann was a very beautiful girl (merch → [f]erch after yn).
karty.mnemo: A HEARTH (HARDD) with a crackling fire: what a beautiful sight on a winter's night.

extra.pozn: harddwch = beauty; the book's definition: pert iawn (p. 127); own sentence based on the story on p. 128

karty.priklad: Darllenwch y cyfarwyddiadau'n fanwl.
karty.priklad_cs: Read the instructions in detail (manwl → [f]anwl after 'n).
karty.mnemo: MANWL ~ MANUAL: a thick, detailed manual.

extra.pozn: yn fanwl = in detail; manylion = details; own example

karty.priklad: Mae'r gwely'n feddal iawn.
karty.priklad_cs: The bed is very soft (meddal → [f]eddal after 'n).
karty.mnemo: A chocolate MEDAL (MEDDAL) gone soft in your hot hand.

extra.pozn: opposite caled = hard; meddalu = to soften; own example

karty.priklad: Maen nhw'n gweithio fel cerddorion proffesiynol.
karty.priklad_cs: They work as professional musicians.
karty.mnemo: From English professional.

extra.pozn: sentence from the article on p. 122

karty.priklad: 'Dyn ni'n griw siaradus.
karty.priklad_cs: We're a chatty bunch (criw → [g]riw after 'n).
karty.mnemo: siarad (to talk) + -us.

extra.pozn: phrase from Robin Radio (p. 130)

karty.priklad: Ddylwn i ddim bod wedi gwisgo siwt mor drwchus!
karty.priklad_cs: I shouldn't have worn such a thick suit! (trwchus → [d]rwchus after mor)
karty.mnemo: Thick fog swallows a whole TRUCK (TRWCH-us).

extra.pozn: trwch = thickness; of cloth, hair, fog; sentence from the dialogue on p. 120

karty.priklad: Dw i'n mynd mas i gael awyr iach.
karty.priklad_cs: I'm going out to get some fresh air (cael → [g]ael after i).
karty.mnemo: awyr (air) + iach (healthy): healthy air that gives you rosy red cheeks.

extra.pozn: in the Geirfa in the arall box; feminine, like awyr (L4); own example

sever.priklad: Dw i'n mynd allan i gael awyr iach.
sever.priklad_cs: I'm going out to get some fresh air (cael → [g]ael after i).

karty.priklad: Maen nhw'n mynd i aros am rai diwrnodau i fwynhau Efrog Newydd.
karty.priklad_cs: They're going to stay a few days to enjoy New York (mwynhau → [f]wynhau after i).
karty.mnemo: Efrog = York.

extra.pozn: sentence from the article on p. 122, adapted

karty.priklad: Cerddon ni o amgylch y llyn.
karty.priklad_cs: We walked around the lake.
karty.mnemo: am + cylch (circle): all the way round in a circle.

extra.pozn: synonym o gwmpas (L2), more usual in southern speech; o amgylch is more literary; own example

karty.priklad: Ysgrifennodd Wil gân i Ann o'r enw 'Bugeilio'r Gwenith Gwyn'.
karty.priklad_cs: Wil wrote a song for Ann called 'Bugeilio'r Gwenith Gwyn' (cân → [g]ân as the object after the subject).
karty.mnemo: enw = name: o'r enw = 'of the name'.

extra.pozn: sentence from the story on p. 128

karty.priklad: Deallais i'r rhan fwya.
karty.priklad_cs: I understood most of it.
karty.mnemo: rhan (part) + mwya (biggest): the biggest part; mwya → fwya after the feminine rhan.

extra.pozn: standard form y rhan fwyaf; y rhan fwya o'r bobl = most people; sentence from p. 124 (colloquial form)

karty.priklad: Pa fath o lyfrau wyt ti'n hoffi darllen?
karty.priklad_cs: What kind of books do you like reading? (llyfrau → [l]yfrau after o)

extra.pozn: pa → soft mutation (math → fath); soft mutation after o (teganau → deganau); phrase from Robin Radio (p. 130), own example

karty.priklad: Roedd hi yn yr uned gofal dwys am wythnos.
karty.priklad_cs: She was in the intensive care unit for a week.
karty.mnemo: gofal (care) + dwys (intense): intensive care, under cold blue lights.

extra.pozn: gender as gofal (L7); dwys = intensive (L14); phrase from Robin Radio (p. 130), own example
